name: healthcare-scheduler-dss
description: DSS Penjadwalan Tenaga Kerja Kesehatan - Genetic Algorithm & AHP

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: cd server && npm install && npx prisma generate --schema=prisma/sqlite.prisma && cd ../client && npm install && npm run build
